Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}.
description:
Activate any number of other creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer, adding an amount of {B} equal to Village Bell-Ringer's mana value.
When Village Bell-Ringer dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Village Bell-Ringer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
